summary_en: 60,000 shares (3.3% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-10 at ¥2,263/share (prior close) for maximum ¥135.78M. Single trading window (08:45 JST). Settlement following trade completion.
title_en: Notice of acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-market transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 7 August 2026, Asahimatsu Foods' board resolved to acquire up to 60,000 treasury shares (3.3% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) for a maximum total consideration of ¥135.78M via a single off-market transaction (ToSTNeT-3) on 10 August 2026 at 08:45 JST. The purchase price is fixed at ¥2,263 per share, the prior day's closing price. The company states the acquisition aims to improve capital efficiency and execute flexible capital policy responsive to changing business conditions. The transaction will be a single-window order at the specified ToSTNeT-3 time slot; no changes to other trading venues or times are planned. Results will be announced immediately after the 08:45 trading window closes. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 61,078 treasury shares and had 1,815,510 shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
